project: players understand wall-running - draft authoring controls
note: Intention-level named handles (Menthol EDIT ME pattern). Ranges in labels are advice, not clamps. Draft workspace is unsigned - never auto-adopts. First-slice: playtest share bar only.

pass_bar.label: Share who must finish unaided
pass_bar.hint: Typical 0.7 to 0.9. Label advice, not a clamp.

time_budget_s.label: Seconds allowed in the tutorial
time_budget_s.hint: Higher makes the bar easier to meet.

require_no_external_help.label: Count external help as not finishing
require_no_external_help.hint: When on, only unaided finishes count toward the share.

log.label: Playtest log file
log.hint: playtest_1.tsv or playtest_2.tsv in the project data folder.

second_bar_enabled.label: Also try a looser candidate bar
second_bar_enabled.hint: Shows two unsigned candidates can disagree. Off by default.

second_bar.label: Looser share bar
second_bar.hint: Used only when the looser-candidate toggle is on.

enabled.label: Compare candidate orderings (question)
enabled.hint: Forms a weighted pair question on scores.tsv. Answers are not claims.

weight_mid.label: Middle weight in the family
weight_mid.hint: Family is 1/4, this middle, 3/4. Label advice 0 to 1.
